2607.21111.title: TOUR: A Trajectory-Level Unlearning Benchmark for Offline Reinforcement Learning
2607.21111.paper_summary: Offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents are trained on fixed behavioral trajectories, which makes trajectory-level deletion important when selected data must be removed after training. Evaluating such deletion is difficult because a lower membership score can reflect trajectory removal, residual memorization visible to another attack, or policy collapse that destroys useful behavior. We introduce Trajectory-level memOrization and Unlearning in offline RL (TOUR), a benchmark that combines trajectory-level partitioning, matched non-member controls, retraining references, retained-performance anchors, and multi-attack privacy auditing. Across D4RL locomotion experiments and an exploratory AntMaze extension, TOUR shows that common deletion baselines have environment-dependent privacy-utility behavior. Retraining and fine-tuning often provide stronger retained-utility references than uniform GA+Refit, while TrajDeleter remains a useful comparator but is not uniformly stronger under the same audit. Reference-model, threshold, deviation, equivalence, action-error, representation-based, and query-limited attacks further show that a single likelihood-based membership score can overstate deletion quality. In the evaluated settings, conclusions about offline RL unlearning are therefore not stable under single-score auditing. They depend on matched non-member construction, retraining-relative calibration, attack family, retained utility, and explicit scope for diagnostic architecture or component-level evidence.
2607.21111.paper_summary_zh: 離線強化學習（RL）代理是在固定的行為軌跡上進行訓練的，因此在訓練後必須刪除所選數據時，軌跡級別的刪除變得重要。 評估這種刪除是困難的，因為較低的成員資格分數可能反映出軌跡的移除、對另一種攻擊可見的殘餘記憶，或摧毀有用行為的策略崩潰。 我們介紹了離線RL中的軌跡級別記憶和遺忘（TOUR），這是一個基準，結合了軌跡級別的劃分、匹配的非成員對照、再訓練參考、保留性能錨點和多重攻擊隱私審計。 在D4RL運動實驗和探索性AntMaze擴展中，TOUR顯示出常見的刪除基準具有環境依賴的隱私效用行為。 再訓練和微調通常提供比均勻的GA+Refit更強的保留效用參考，而TrajDeleter仍然是一個有用的比較者，但在相同的審計下並不總是更強。 參考模型、閾值、偏差、等價性、行動錯誤、基於表示的攻擊和查詢限制攻擊進一步表明，單一的基於可能性的成員資格分數可能會高估刪除質量。 因此，在評估的設置中，關於離線RL遺忘的結論在單一分數審計下並不穩定。 它們依賴於匹配的非成員構造、相對於再訓練的校準、攻擊家族、保留效用以及診斷架構或組件級證據的明確範疇。
